🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 5, 2026

Moon, in Virgo, holds an opposition to Neptune, in Aries. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 2-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Neptune is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Cardinal fire opens and closes the same file. The sextile to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. Moon trines you from Virgo, meeting no resistance. Fixed earth holds, and holding asks nothing back. Since Venus crossed out of Scorpio, the question has changed.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Virgo, Moon cuts across the appetite. Air that changes shape, charged for each shape. The hold Mars had a week ago is not there any more.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, untitled in Virgo. Venus squares you from Libra, and the cost objects. Cardinal water starts and is invoiced for it. A week ago Moon was still held by Venus; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Scorpio. From Scorpio, Mercury sets a figure against the wanting. Fixed fire: the grip costs more than the thing. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Earth shifts until the two options are one. Mercury turned back two weeks ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Mars sextiles you from Leo: help that waits to be asked for. Cardinal air: the opening move is the cheap one. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. From Virgo, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Water that holds on, holding without strain. Nothing about it is a week old.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Moon squares you from Virgo: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Mutable fire keeps two accounts open and pays both. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Virgo, Moon concedes the point early. Earth that starts things, started cheaply. The same angle for two weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Mercury in Scorpio presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Fixed air: the grip is the expense. The trine of two weeks ago is off it now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Virgo sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Water adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.
